card.name: Words leading up to death
card.fires_on: Words in a phrase where the next word is likely death or dying, such as kill, last breath, fatal dysrhythmias, or caused by after a death. It is strongest on the word just before the death term.

modes.label: Verbs and phrases of dying

modes.label: Fatal event wording
modes.description: Mid-word or linking word in fatal outcome descriptions, such as dysrhythmias or caused by.
modes.example: Deaths occurred within 2 minutes and were caused<< by>> respiratory paralysis.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward writing death, dying and apoptosis next.
